contact.basis: Original grade just north of the Puerta del Perdón at the courtyard entry.

method: Original Terrarium values bilinearly sampled before model authoring, with no cut, replacement or flattening.
limitations: This is a medium-fi exterior of the standing monument. Exact contemporary glazing, reliefs, sculpture, inscriptions, paged roof alterations, furnishings and interiors are outside the modeled detail.
